content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to understand how to use analog inputs in [product_name] and how to perform scaling. I have connected a sensor and set the measurement range in the analog threshold trigger. Also, what is the purpose of the analog amplifier? Thank you, [user_name]

Hi, this function block amplifies an analog value and outputs it as an analog signal. If you select the block and press F1, a help window will appear with a description of the block and details on how to configure its parameters. Hope this clarifies things. Regards,

[product_name] analog inputs accept standard signals such as 0-10V or 0-20mA. These inputs may come from sensors with different ranges and units, so scaling is required to reflect the actual range of physical signals. To scale: If your physical signal is between values a and b, you need to convert your input (0-10) to match this range (a-b). To do this, calculate the correct gain and offset: gain = (b - a) / 10 (for 0-10V signals), offset = a. For 0-20mA inputs, the process is similar, involving a linear relationship between input and scaled signal. Refer to [product_name] help for more details.
